id: \bNorman: Excuse me. Wait just a moment.
en: \bNorman: Excuse me. Wait just a moment.

id: \bYou're \PN, aren't you? My daughter said you were looking to challenge the Gym Leaders here.
en: \bYou're \PN, aren't you? My daughter said you were looking to challenge the Gym Leaders here.
it: \bTu sei \PN, vero? Mia figlia mi ha detto che vuoi sfidare i Capipalestra di questa regione.

id: \bI don't think you're ready to face me but I'll gladly give you a taste of what's to come. Let's begin.
en: \bI don't think you're ready to face me but I'll gladly give you a taste of what's to come. Let's begin.
it: \bNon credo tu sia pronto ad affrontarmi, ma ti darò volentieri un assaggio di ciò che ti aspetta. Cominciamo.

id: \bNorman: I see. I look forward to your official challenge.
en: \bNorman: I see. I look forward to your official challenge.
it: \bNorman: Capisco. Attendo con ansia la tua sfida ufficiale.

id: \bThe woods to the west of us are called Petalburg Woods. Kinda strange since it isn't in Petalburg.
en: \bThe woods to the west of us are called Petalburg Woods. Kinda strange since it isn't in Petalburg.
it: \bIl bosco a ovest di qui si chiama Bosco Petalo. Un po' strano, visto che non si trova a Petalipoli.

id: \bThis is a great town, but there are even nicer places to connect to nature out there.
en: \bThis is a great town, but there are even nicer places to connect to nature out there.
it: \bQuesta è una bella città, ma là fuori ci sono posti ancora migliori per stare a contatto con la natura.

id: Petalburg City\nWhere people mingle with nature.
en: Petalburg City\nWhere people mingle with nature.
it: Petalipoli\nDove la gente vive in armonia con la natura.

id: \rMy Old Rod is only catching the simple things. I wish I had an upgrade.
en: \rMy Old Rod is only catching the simple things. I wish I had an upgrade.
it: \rCon il mio Amo Vecchio pesco solo cose banali. Vorrei tanto qualcosa di meglio.
Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Petalipoli: \nNorman

id: A man in pursuit of power!
en: A man in pursuit of power!
it: Un uomo alla ricerca della forza!

id: \bNorman is training right now and will not be taking challenges.
en: \bNorman is training right now and will not be taking challenges.
it: \bNorman si sta allenando e al momento non accetta sfide.

id: \rYou're here to challenge my dad. Well let's see if you can beat me first. I've been wanting to try out some new moves.
en: \rYou're here to challenge my dad. Well let's see if you can beat me first. I've been wanting to try out some new moves.
it: \rSei qui per sfidare mio papà. Beh, vediamo prima se riesci a battere me. Non vedevo l'ora di provare qualche nuova mossa.

id: \rMay: That was a lot of fun. Good luck facing my dad.
en: \rMay: That was a lot of fun. Good luck facing my dad.
it: \rVera: Mi sono proprio divertita. Buona fortuna contro mio papà.

id: \rMay: Hi \PN. What do you think of my hometown? It's pretty nice isn't it?
en: \rMay: Hi \PN. What do you think of my hometown?  It's pretty nice isn't it?
it: \rVera: Ciao \PN. Che ne pensi della mia città natale?  È proprio carina, vero?
